name: Sialkot
scopeLimits: The WUP point is a population-weighted locator, not a parcel identity. A Sialkot-named PULSE layer is a credible local source, but the service returned only a token requirement. City extent coverage, current parcel distribution, fields, geometry and exact point match remain unverified. PULSE itself says its indicative lines are not legal boundaries.
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
registryBasis: The official Punjab PULSE interactive viewer lists a Cadastral Maps > Sialkot layer. Its map service exposes a Sialkot-named sublayer, but anonymous service metadata and bounded identify/query attempts return ArcGIS HTTP 499 Token Required. The local Revenue Department Sialkot portal is also an official city/district revenue office. This identifies a city-specific map source, but does not establish exact WUP-point coverage or parcel geometry.
